reviewContext.userProblem: After merging main (manual-run overlap busy check, terminal reserve) into feat/instance-cancel, three focused test areas fail: ConfiguredLaunchCancelTests (second same-identity launch now 409 instance_busy), TaskCancellationIntegrationTests selected-host stop proof ('Worker did not reach its delayed stop receipt'), and WorkflowDefinitionStoreTests (expects schema generation 11, store is at 12). The user also requires that after a cancel, a new instance run is not refused with instance_busy.
requiredOutcomes: After a cancel (store reads cancelled), a new same-identity launch without allowOverlap is not refused with instance_busy (rule-1 narrowing, DR-01, with deterministic regression test).
Branch integrated into main (fast-forward after re-fetching origin/main) and pushed.
nonGoals: No change to rule 2 / LiveRootSessionProbe, allowOverlap wire shape, --allow-overlap, 409 body, CLI instance_busy mapping, cron overlap probe or docs/app-instance-control.md.
No change to C8 LocalProcess 5 s SIGTERM grace or any Sources/RielaAdapters file.
No weakening or removal of any existing assertion.
constraints: Work only in worktree /Users/taco/gits/tacogips/riela-worktrees/instance-cancel on feat/instance-cancel; never modify the main checkout /Users/taco/gits/tacogips/riela or its .build.
Do not restart/kill/reconfigure the running RielaApp; do not modify ~/.riela/** or installed binaries; tests use temp stores and fake processes.
Run swift build / swift test / swiftlint via /usr/bin/arch -arm64 /bin/zsh -lc.
Each worker edits only its writePaths; logs go under tmp/instance-cancel-integration/<int-0N>/.
Fresh-read sha256 before/after each edit; stop on drift; git read-only for workers.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: ConfiguredLaunchCancelTests: second concurrent launch passes allowOverlap:true; add third-launch 409 instance_busy assertion and post-cancel 202 end-to-end check (design §8.1).
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: 409 on a second same-identity launch is main's intended busy semantics, not a cancel defect.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: DR-01: rule 1 of the busy check ignores a running in-process launch whose known sessionId is persisted terminal (cancelled/completed/failed) via read-only loadStrictReadOnly; pending, created/running, missing DB/record or read errors still block (fail-closed); rule 2 unchanged (fail-open).
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Runner persists cancelled before job.finish flips the snapshot and instance cancel --wait returns on store cancelled, so rule 1 would refuse a launch for a store-terminal session (design §8.1, user-qa item 2).

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Selected-host stop-proof fixture: replace 4 s proofDeadline with a named bound >= grace 5 + hard bound 5 + margin; confirm hypothesis first at 293527c8 (git archive) and unmodified HEAD; no Sources change.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Regression comes from the branch's documented C8 5 s SIGTERM grace vs a TERM-ignoring fixture waiting only 4 s; main touched no Adapters/Work/Server code (design §8.2, user-qa item 1).

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: WorkflowDefinitionStoreTests assert String(SQLiteWorkflowRuntimePersistenceStore.schemaGeneration) and pin it to 12; rename test to ...AtCurrentGeneration.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Generation 12 is intended by design-session-storage-efficiency-and-default-gc.md §3.2 (additive DDL); tests are stale (design §8.3).

intentionalTradeoffs: Keeping the 5 s cancellation grace makes the selected-host test slower (>= 12 s bound) rather than changing documented cancel behavior.
Rule 1 does a read-only store lookup per running same-identity launch; fail-closed on read errors.
Three wave-1 plans share one .build; SwiftPM build lock serializes their swift test runs.
supportedEdgeCases: Running launch with session persisted cancelled -> 202 (Case A).
Running launch with no session id -> 409 runningSessionId pending (Case B).
Running launch with session persisted running -> 409 with that session (Case C).
Running launch with unpersisted session -> 409 fail-closed (Case D).
Missing store DB is never created by the busy check.
outOfScopeEdgeCases: Persisted 'created' companion case not separately tested (status predicate covers it).
LocalProcess real defects (executor never throws, tree survives grace + hard bound) are reported as blockers, not fixed in int-02.
Cross-process pre-allocation race window (accepted by main's design §3.5).
